features.title: read, write, edit and read_image tools
features.summary: The forked filesystem tools keep upstream's sandbox checks, approvals and fs/observed receipts; read also reads from the end with a negative offset, answers an offset past the end with the last lines and the line count, suggests close names for a missing file, and never splits a character when it shortens a long line.
failureModes: A profile whose preset-standard row still names @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs keeps the native tools.

verification.testName: reads from the end with a negative offset
returns the last lines and the line count for an offset past the end
suggests close names when the file is missing
ranks other case, then other extension, then small typos, and ignores unrelated names
never cuts a multi-byte character when it shortens a long line

features.currentSurface: agent tools: read, write, edit, read_image
